1. Hi Mum, we arrived at the guest-house. The walk was long, but we enjoyed it. Please collect us here at four. Eva

2. NATURE WALK — We changed the start point. Meet at the car park instead of the train station.

3. TOURIST DESK — We moved to the airport hall yesterday. You can still collect town maps there.

4. Dear guests, we cleaned the dining room this morning. Please eat your sandwiches in the garden today.

5. Hi Sam, I saved your train ticket. It is in my suitcase, not on the table. Ask me before we leave. Jo

6. PHOTO CLUB — We photographed the coast yesterday. Please send your best picture to the teacher by Friday.
